items.title: Scott Robinson interviewed by Monk Rowe,Chautauqua, New York, September 13, 1997
items.q: Congressman John Conyers holds that every year.

ctx.x: Tell me about your visit to the Black Caucus Jazz Forum.

Oh, when was that? That was — it must have been like eight years ago or something. That’s — Congressman John Conyers holds that every year. It’s the Congressional Black Caucus. They meet and discuss jazz related issues. This is where the resolution to declare jazz a national treasure, this is how that was engendered, through these meetings and these discussions. They called me up and said well we’re having a panel about jazz and the family, and we want you to come and speak. And I don’t really come from a jazz…
